title: Calamum Data Integrity & Signing Remediation
objectives: Retire 'Ghost Data' (empty heartbeats) and archive evidence.
Implement HMAC-SHA256 data signing in the obfuscation pipeline.
Wire the active Moltbook Sampler into the Agent loop.
Separate metadata streams (Health) from intelligence streams (Data).
Reset dashboard counters to reflect true intelligence volume.

tasks.title: Archive Ghost Data
tasks.description: Move the existing 6.5MB heartbeat file to `logs/data/calamum/archive/` as evidence of the simulation anomaly.

tasks.title: Implement Data Signing
tasks.description: Update `obfuscator_lib.py` to accept a signing key and append an HMAC-SHA256 signature to every generic record.

tasks.title: Update Agent Logic
tasks.description: Refactor `calamum_observer_agent.py` to import `calamum_sampler`, instantiate the client, and loop over real feed data instead of hardcoded placeholders.

tasks.title: Separate Streams
tasks.description: Configure the agent to write heartbeats to `logs/health/calamum_observer.heartbeat.jsonl` (or rotate them) and data to the main metrics file.

tasks.title: Validation Run
tasks.description: Run the agent for >1 minute. Verify output file contains signed, varied data. Verify dashboard counter increments normally.

constraints: No external API calls (Simulation/Canary mode only for now unless explicitly wired to live).
